name: CRC real Oxford verification sites v1
description: Twelve purposive engineering comparisons, not a statistical validation sample. Six official designation reference polygons and six explicitly bounded sample windows. No environmental measurements are supplied by this file. Expectations are qualitative and must never become model inputs.

properties.name: Port Meadow with Wolvercote Common & Green
properties.boundary_type: Natural England SSSI public reference polygon; not ownership boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Low-gradient active floodplain; strong physical wetland characteristics are plausible. Existing valuable wetland/meadow does not establish restoration need or justify habitat conversion.

properties.name: Hook Meadow and The Trap Grounds
properties.boundary_type: Natural England SSSI public reference polygon; not ownership boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Thames floodplain meadow: low gradient and water adjacency expected; current habitat requires protection and restoration need remains unmeasured.

properties.name: Iffley Meadows
properties.boundary_type: Natural England SSSI public reference polygon; not ownership boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: River Thames floodplain meadows: low gradient and flood context expected; established valuable meadow is not evidence of degradation.

properties.name: Pixey and Yarnton Meads
properties.boundary_type: Natural England SSSI public reference polygon; not ownership boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Protected Thames floodplain meadows: strong hydrological setting is plausible, with habitat safeguards and unknown restoration need.

properties.name: Wolvercote Meadows
properties.boundary_type: Natural England SSSI public reference polygon; not ownership boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Oxford Meadows SAC floodplain grassland: low gradient and river context expected; ecological condition and intervention need require assessment.

properties.name: New Marston Meadows
properties.boundary_type: Natural England SSSI public reference polygon; not ownership boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Cherwell floodplain hay/grazing meadows: strong floodplain/water context expected; condition and restoration need unknown.

properties.name: Wytham Woods eastern hillside sample
properties.boundary_type: Analyst-selected rectangular sampling window at a real location; not property, project or reserve boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Wooded hillside: steeper terrain than floodplain examples and known woodland should constrain open-wetland creation; local springs/fens can occur and whole woodland is not uniformly dry.

properties.name: Westgate shopping centre sample
properties.boundary_type: Analyst-selected rectangular sampling window at a real location; not property, project or reserve boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Major developed retail fabric: high developed fraction expected; simple open-wetland restoration opportunity should be constrained. Physical floodplain context alone cannot override development.

properties.name: Oxford railway station sample
properties.boundary_type: Analyst-selected rectangular sampling window at a real location; not property, project or reserve boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Active rail station and infrastructure: rail/development evidence expected and ordinary wetland creation should be constrained.

properties.name: Seacourt Park and Ride sample
properties.boundary_type: Analyst-selected rectangular sampling window at a real location; not property, project or reserve boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Operational car park in floodplain setting: water context may be strong while current development constrains conversion. Council reports its expansion also stores floodwater; low feasibility and wet physical setting can coexist.

properties.name: Osney Mead industrial estate sample
properties.boundary_type: Analyst-selected rectangular sampling window at a real location; not property, project or reserve boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Industrial/brownfield land in floodplain: developed evidence should constrain conversion even with strong water context; no inference about future redevelopment permissions.

properties.name: Redbridge Park and Ride sample
properties.boundary_type: Analyst-selected rectangular sampling window at a real location; not property, project or reserve boundary
properties.expected_qualitative: Operational car park: current hard development/infrastructure should constrain straightforward wetland creation despite low-lying setting.
